Follow the schema: `/devkit change` runs a change from your request to its archive (`ship-change` still finishes a change begun under the previous script), and `flow-check` is the read-only readout of the stages (`node <worktree>/plugins/openspec/hooks/flow-check.mjs feat` says which passed and which is next); `openspec instructions <artifact> --change <name>` says how each stage is written. A stage's instruction names its role; in Claude Code a role is the devkit-core agent of the same name, dispatched with the Agent tool (`owner` is you asking the owner, `change-coordinator` is this session, `review-bench` is the review-change skill). Gate files have one writer each (readiness.md: plan-readiness-reviewer; reviews/<reviewer>.md: that reviewer; evidence.md: pr-verifier); in the devkit schema, product code is written by tdd-implementer after readiness is APPROVED. Dispatch those agents with the Agent tool.
